description: Per-component temporal sweep receipt (scripts/oracle/temporal-kinds/run.sh). Each suite records the Mobile revision and the JAR used for the run.

evolution.note: SHA-256 of the JAR in build/libs in the Evolution d58a61e0 checkout, built at 06:09 -0300 on 2026-11-07 using JDK 21.0.13. The receipts were committed at 08:44 -0300. The hash was read from the JAR during receipt conversion on 2026-11-07 because the sweep README omitted it.

suites.command: scripts/oracle/temporal-kinds/run.sh EVOLUTION_JAR WORK/default CORE_JAR (python3 scripts/parity_matrix.py reverify temporal-kinds --suites default)
scripts/oracle/temporal-kinds/run.sh --variants EVOLUTION_JAR WORK/variants CORE_JAR (python3 scripts/parity_matrix.py reverify temporal-kinds --suites variants)
scripts/oracle/temporal-kinds/run.sh --variants --negative EVOLUTION_JAR WORK/negative CORE_JAR (python3 scripts/parity_matrix.py reverify temporal-kinds --suites negative)
scripts/oracle/temporal-kinds/run.sh --pairs 6 EVOLUTION_JAR WORK/pairs CORE_JAR (python3 scripts/parity_matrix.py reverify temporal-kinds --suites pairs)

ResaveDesktop WORK/variants/fixtures, then TemporalCorpusCli settle on each <id>.desktop.circ against the Evolution trace for the original (python3 scripts/parity_matrix.py reverify temporal-kinds --suites roundtrip)
